correctness.rationale: The spectral decomposition is derived by an explicitly defined rank-q UV term and reversal involution R; its determinant is checked algebraically. The matrix-tree cofactor is determined by the characteristic derivative of a balanced strongly connected graph. BEST counts cycles with a fixed labeled arc, avoiding cyclic overcounting. Case q=2 separate. A complete symbolic proof covers all q>=2; integer cofactor calculations q=2..6 and two distinct exact finite Euler-tour enumeration methods q=2,3 corroborate.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Generic directed BEST and matrix-tree count expressions apply in principle to this family but do not evaluate its graph-specific determinant. General sampling theorems and existence guarantees therefore do not logically imply the precise closed count without a new algebraic evaluation.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The exact present statement counts Euler circuits in G_q with edges abc satisfying a!=c, modulo rotation. Leitner-Godbole restricted classes are non-bijections and others, not this edge set; Chen-Kitaev-Sun counts conditions on specified missing words; Sawada-Gabric offers a general random generator but not this characteristic factorization or exact count. Prior methods are acknowledged in proof; only the evaluated all-q product is proposed as new.

originality.rationale: Full-primary-text comparison identified general restricted-word existence, removed-word existence probabilities, and universal-cycle generation from spanning arborescences, but none evaluated the forbidden-3-palindrome characteristic polynomial and cyclic count. The exact closed product and factorization are the limited originality claim; general graph counting and existence are prior art.

value.rationale: This is a natural restricted-word system forbidding length-three palindromes, equivalently instantaneous backtracking. It determines the entire exact solution-space size at every alphabet size and supplies a low-rank spectral evaluation rather than an arbitrary small finite table. The explicit cardinality is not determined by existence alone and is useful for enumeration and sampling benchmarks.
